span.p:
lock_key = “lock:profile:42”
lock_acquired = cache.set(lock_key, “1”, nx=True, ex=5)
if lock_acquired:
result = db.query(...)
cache.set(“profile:42”, result, ex=300)
cache.delete(lock_key)
else:
sleep(0.01)
return cache.get(“profile:42”) # retry
